## Overview

`dicomtk` 0.4.0 introduces end-to-end support for **DICOM Segmentation (`SEG`)**, **Radiotherapy (`RTSTRUCT` and `RTDOSE`)**, **Quantitative Structured Reports (`TID 1500`)**, **Grayscale Presentation States (`GSPS`)**, **Automated Image Quality Control**, and **ML Dataset Exporters (`nnU-Net v2`, `MONAI`, `RO-Crate`, `Croissant`)**.

## 1. Creating and Writing a DICOM Segmentation (`dicom_seg`)

Because `dicom_seg` inherits from `dicom_volume`, it preserves full 3D LPS/RAS spatial geometry alongside segment metadata:

```{r}
library(dicomtk)

synth <- dicom_synthesize(modality = "CT", dims = c(32L, 32L, 6L))
vol <- read_dicom_volume(synth[["out_dir"]])

mask <- array(0L, dim = dim(vol))
mask[10:22, 10:22, 2:5] <- 1L

seg <- dicom_seg(
  mask = mask,
  ref_volume = vol,
  segments = tibble::tibble(segment_id = 1L, label = "Liver")
)
seg
```

## 2. Automated Image Quality Control (`dicom_image_qc`)

Before feeding volumes into a downstream pipeline or ML trainer, run `dicom_image_qc()` to check SNR, CNR, FOV border truncation, slice spacing anomalies, gantry tilt, and high-frequency ringing:

```{r}
qc <- dicom_image_qc(vol)
qc$qc_status
```

## 3. Deep Learning Preprocessing (`volume_resample`, `volume_window`)

Resample volumes to isotropic voxel spacing and apply clinical HU windowing:

```{r}
vol_iso <- volume_resample(vol, target_spacing = c(2, 2, 2), method = "trilinear")
vol_win <- volume_window(vol_iso, center = 40, width = 400, normalize = "minmax")
range(vol_win$voxels)
```

## 4. Cleanup

```{r, include = FALSE}
unlink(synth[["out_dir"]], recursive = TRUE)
```
